def load_official(runtime):
    """Same actual official-module loading mechanism as the successful meta worker."""
    name = '_spark26_pinned_' + contract.original.REVISION
    require(name not in sys.modules, 'Fresh official pinned package')
    package = types.ModuleType(name)
    package.__path__ = [str(contract.original.SOURCE_DIR)]
    sys.modules[name] = package
    loaded = []
    for suffix, path in [('configuration_spark', contract.original.CONFIGURATION),
                         ('modeling_spark', contract.original.MODELING)]:
        runtime.check_origin(str(path))
        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name + '.' + suffix, path)
        module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
        sys.modules[spec.name] = module
        spec.loader.exec_module(module)
        loaded.append(module)
    return loaded

                  NeuronModelBase=NeuronModelBase)
    import spark26_native_port_diagnostic_v3 as diagnostic
    diagnostic.validate_native_objects(result)
    runtime.native_mappings()
    return result

    """Exercise actual host sort and inverse restore with real tensor inputs.

    A minimal receiver selects the documented ordinary-cache method branch.

def create_local_weight_qkv(rank, world_size, full_weight, partition_dim, q_len, kv_len, out_weight=None):
    # Shard q,k,v weights separately and then fuse them for each rank
    q_weight, k_weight, v_weight = torch.split(full_weight, [q_len, kv_len, kv_len], dim=partition_dim)
    q_weight_list = torch.split(q_weight, divide(q_len, world_size), dim=partition_dim)[rank::world_size]
    k_weight_list = torch.split(k_weight, divide(kv_len, world_size), dim=partition_dim)[rank::world_size]
    v_weight_list = torch.split(v_weight, divide(kv_len, world_size), dim=partition_dim)[rank::world_size]

    with torch.no_grad():
        return torch.cat(
            (
                torch.cat(q_weight_list, dim=partition_dim),
                torch.cat(k_weight_list, dim=partition_dim),
                torch.cat(v_weight_list, dim=partition_dim),
            ),
            dim=partition_dim,
            out=out_weight,
